name: Vu 2017 erenumab QSS TMDD and CIDBF PK/PD scenarios
description: Exact paper-parameter checks and deterministic SC/IV simulations for the Vu et al. 2017 erenumab PK/PD model.

scenarios.name: Table III PK parameter estimates
scenarios.description: Exact rounded Table III population PK parameter estimates and random-effect/residual-error summaries.

scenarios.name: Table IV PD parameter estimates
scenarios.description: Exact rounded Table IV capsaicin-induced dermal blood-flow PD parameter estimates and variability summaries.

scenarios.name: Population, threshold, and dose-selection text checks
scenarios.description: Exact paper and supplement text values for data size, ADA counts, IC99, nonlinear clearance, body-weight percentiles, and selected dose-regimen statements.

scenarios.name: 7 mg SC Q4W 75 kg deterministic simulation
scenarios.description: The 7 mg SC monthly dose selected to demonstrate a non-effective dose in phase 2 dose selection; deterministic median-weight simulation without population variability.

scenarios.name: 21 mg SC Q4W 75 kg deterministic simulation
scenarios.description: Monthly 21 mg SC dose-selection simulation at the phase 1 median body weight; paper reports this regimen placed more than 50% of subjects above IC99 after the second dose in stochastic simulations.

scenarios.name: 70 mg SC Q4W 75 kg deterministic simulation
scenarios.description: Monthly 70 mg SC dose-selection simulation at the phase 1 median body weight; paper reports all subjects were expected to exceed mean IC99 within the first dose.

scenarios.name: 21 mg SC Q4W 68 kg Supplementary Fig. S8 simulation
scenarios.description: Deterministic Supplementary Figure S8 simulation for three monthly SC doses at 68 kg, extended to 24.5 weeks so the published PK and DBF-inhibition terminal decline can be compared.

scenarios.name: 21 mg SC Q4W 84 kg Supplementary Fig. S8 simulation
scenarios.description: Deterministic Supplementary Figure S8 simulation for three monthly SC doses at 84 kg, extended to 24.5 weeks so the published PK and DBF-inhibition terminal decline can be compared.

scenarios.name: 70 mg SC Q4W 68 kg Supplementary Fig. S8 simulation
scenarios.description: Deterministic Supplementary Figure S8 simulation for three monthly SC doses at 68 kg, extended to 24.5 weeks so the published PK and DBF-inhibition terminal decline can be compared.

scenarios.name: 70 mg SC Q4W 84 kg Supplementary Fig. S8 simulation
scenarios.description: Deterministic Supplementary Figure S8 simulation for three monthly SC doses at 84 kg, extended to 24.5 weeks so the published PK and DBF-inhibition terminal decline can be compared.

scenarios.name: 140 mg IV single-infusion deterministic simulation
scenarios.description: IV infusion path exercising the paper's Atot(0)=DoseIV branch using an input rate into the central total amount. This is a runtime smoke scenario, not a reproduced figure.
